body.label: Target
body.html: Two creatures within 4 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Swap the targets' spaces if both are willing or successfully affected; both destinations must be supported and have a clear connecting path. Each hit enemy is Distracted until the start of your next turn, even if the swap fails.

surges.html: One willing moved target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Fey
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Fey Full Manifestation (FM-2F). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
